concern_details: Which runtime environments and software artifacts are required to run the system?
Where are the application and its data executed and stored?
How do the main runtime elements communicate with each other?
Which technologies and runtime dependencies are involved in the communication between the application and the database?
views.reason: All four concerns were tagged runtime-environment (one also with runtime-parts), which the deployment viewpoint frames. Nodes and execution environments answer what is required to run the system. Placing artifacts on nodes shows where the application and its data run and are stored. Communication paths, labelled with protocols and drivers, show how runtime elements talk to each other and which technologies and dependencies link the application to the database. One deployment view therefore covers everything, which is the fewest views.

also.reason: The third concern also touched runtime-parts. A component diagram would show the running parts and their interfaces, and how they connect, about as well as the deployment communication paths do. It does not show nodes, execution environments or where data is stored, so it is only a partial alternative for that concern.
